title: Stage 6 stochastic-source audit outcome rules
purpose: Classify the outcome of a bounded static stochastic-source audit. A static hit does not prove execution dependence and a clean scan does not prove determinism; these rules map audit inputs and recorded dynamic dispositions to one of five outcomes with required remediation.

input_fields.inventory_declared: boolean; scanner version, categories scanned, and scan scope are declared
input_fields.hits: list of records with fields: category, executes_dynamically, changes_execution_relation, bounded_or_disabled, evidence_recorded

outcomes.meaning: A stochastic mechanism was found and its influence on the compared executions was bounded or disabled with recorded evidence.
outcomes.claim_effect: Supports treating the audited mechanism as controlled for the exercised schedule; does not by itself prove determinism.

outcomes.meaning: A mechanism remains possible and was not shown estimand-changing, so claims are downgraded rather than suppressed.
outcomes.claim_effect: Paired wording may not assert mechanistic equivalence; repeatability claims rest only on Stages 4-5 evidence.

outcomes.meaning: A mechanism directly changes the execution relation needed by the comparison.
outcomes.claim_effect: Paired mechanistic claims are suppressed for the affected comparison.

outcomes.meaning: Source was unavailable or the boundary is black-box, blocking any source-level claim.
outcomes.claim_effect: Stronger source-level claims are blocked; lower-stage evidence stands unchanged.

outcomes.meaning: A hit exists but the recorded evidence is insufficient to classify it; no automatic pass exists.
outcomes.claim_effect: Claims are downgraded until remediation produces a classification.

rules.remediation: None available at this boundary; record the uninspected boundary explicitly and rely on Stages 4-5 behavioral evidence.
Rerun the audit with a declared scanner version, category list, and scope; an undeclared inventory invalidates the stage.
Disable or bound the mechanism, re-verify Stages 4-5 on the modified configuration, and re-acquire before any paired claim.
Record the bounding intervention and its evidence in the audit log; monitor for scope drift on future artifacts.
Bound or disable the executing mechanism with recorded dynamic evidence, then reclassify under rule controlled_hit.
Collect dynamic evidence showing whether the branch executes and whether its effect is bounded; no automatic pass exists for any hit.
No remediation can convert a clean static scan into a determinism proof; rely on Stage 4-5 repeatability evidence for the exercised contexts and state the residual risk.
rules.note: A zero-hit scan never yields CONTROLLED because control requires a found-and-bounded mechanism.

fail_closed_note: Unrecognized inputs, missing fields, and out-of-order evaluation default to UNRESOLVED.
